name: Witch House
summary: Visually, the aesthetic is defined by its use of occult symbols like triangles and crosses, distorted or glitchy low-resolution imagery, and a general dark, horror-inspired atmosphere.
description: Visually, the aesthetic is defined by its use of occult symbols like triangles and crosses, distorted or glitchy low-resolution imagery, and a general dark, horror-inspired atmosphere. The name itself, coined somewhat jokingly by musician Travis Egedy (Pictureplane) in december 2009, became the established term for the scene, which first gained traction on platforms like SoundCloud, Myspace and Bandcamp.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Occultism, surrealism, nocturnal themes, horror, dark atmospheres, DIY ethos

visualDNA.colour: Black, desaturated colors, dark red, purple, blue
